# **Defect 01 \- Enter First Name or Last Name Fields Using Emojis**

**Module**: PIM \-\> Add Employee  
**Severity**: Minor    
**Priority**: Low  
**Status**: Open  
**Environment**: Chrome, Windows 11

### **Description**

Verify the system rejects or handles errors related to emoji input in the “first name” and “last name” fields.

### **Steps-to-Reproduce**

1. Login to [https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login](https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login)   
2. Navigate to Add Employee from PIM  
3. Type:  
   First name: “🙌”  
   Last name: “😄”  
4. Click ‘Save’ button  
5. View employee data in the Employee List

### **Expected Result** 

Failed to create a new employee. The displayed validation error or emoji must be correct.

### **Actual Result**

Emoji displayed with question mark (?) after saving data.
